name: Efreeti Chain
description: A shirt and hood of brass rings, hot as coals, that never burn the one who wears them.
body:
## What it does

This chain mail guards far better than plain steel. Fire cannot harm you in it, you can speak and understand Primordial, and you can stand and walk on molten rock as on solid ground.

features.name: Primordial
features.text: You can speak and understand Primordial.

features.name: Firewalker
features.text: You can stand on and walk across molten rock as if it were solid ground.
